# statusdrift_collaborators (Data Source)

Fetches all organization members.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "statusdrift_collaborators" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `collaborators` (Attributes List) List of organization members. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--collaborators))
- `id` (String) Placeholder ID for Terraform state.

<a id="nestedatt--collaborators"></a>
### Nested Schema for `collaborators`

Read-Only:

- `email` (String) The email address.
- `id` (Number) The ID of the organization member.
- `name` (String) The full name.
- `role` (String) The organization role.
- `status` (String) The membership status.
